Name: Tax Reborn
Description: Prepare a US tax year 2025 return with Tax Reborn's full browser interface.
Workflow: Enter information, review calculations, save locally, and export preparation records.
Features: Full upstream browser interface
Local saved returns and document review
Federal calculations, state drafts and preparation exports
Limitations: Experimental tax year 2025 preview. No electronic filing. Native features and full original .tax compatibility are not supported. Large initial runtime download.
License: Tax Reborn: AGPL-3.0-only. Complete corresponding source and dependency notices are available alongside the editor.
Access: Free browser interface; no AICraft account required.
DataHandling: Offline mode uses local browser storage. Export backups before clearing site data. Embedded editors share the site's origin.

Name: Photo lab
Description: Adjust color, crop, rotate, flip, and export a PNG with PhotoCraft.
Features: Exposure, saturation, hue and grayscale adjustments
Percentage cropping, quarter-turn rotation and horizontal/vertical flips
Original/edited comparison and PNG export
Limitations: 20 MB input; working copies capped at 4 MP and 2560 pixels per side. PNG export omits source metadata. No layer-based photo editing.
License: Upstream engine: MIT OR Apache-2.0. AICraft integration: MIT.
Access: Free to use in your browser. No AICraft account or subscription required.
DataHandling: Selected files are processed in browser workers. The lab does not upload documents. Downloads are saved on your device.

Name: PDF lab
Description: Preview, merge, extract, reorder, and rotate pages with PdfCraft.
Features: Inline PDF preview with separate-tab fallback
Append PDFs and extract or reorder selected pages
Rotate exported pages
Limitations: 15 MB combined input, 200 pages, 30 MB output and a 30-second worker deadline. No encrypted PDFs, signature fields, text editing or redaction. Some document-level features do not carry over.
License: Upstream engine: MIT OR Apache-2.0. AICraft integration: MIT.
Access: Free to use in your browser. No AICraft account or subscription required.
DataHandling: Selected files are processed in browser workers. The lab does not upload documents. Downloads are saved on your device.

Name: Ledger Reborn
Description: The full Ledger Reborn interface with browser-local books and reviewed bank imports.
Features: Customers, vendors, invoices, bills, payments and inventory
Journals, projects, budgets, period locks and reports
Bank import, matching, reconciliation and SQLite backup export
Limitations: Preview release, USD only. Bank export requires the separate Azure bank site and Microsoft/Plaid sign-in. Imports require review before posting. No payroll, tax filing or payment execution. SQLite restore requires the desktop edition.
License: Ledger Reborn interface and engine: MIT. AICraft integration: MIT.
Access: Local ledger is free without sign-in. Optional bank feed requires Microsoft sign-in and configured Azure/Plaid services; provider costs may apply.
DataHandling: Local ledger records stay in IndexedDB. The optional connected-bank feed uses Microsoft sign-in, Plaid and your Azure API/SQL database. Bank access tokens are encrypted on the server; disconnect deletes the imported feed.
